entry.goal: Tukuyin ang gamit at pahintulot. / Route by medium and permission.

web.goal: Web, editorial, marketing and UI: verify language markup, wrapping, readable actions and actual accessibility behavior.

documents.goal: Reports, publishing and presentations: verify print/export, hierarchy, viewing distance, fonts and text extraction.

review.goal: Read-only findings, source evidence and separate proposals; no writeback.

font_size: Conditional trials only; record units, reader, font, width and distance. No Tagalog national average.
